- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (add/update tests for new tools)
- [ ] `pnpm build` produces a clean build
- [ ] Both `title`/`titleDe`, `description`/`descriptionDe`, `explanation`/`explanationDe`, `useCases`/`useCasesDe` filled in (for new tools)
- [ ] `rawOutput` set if the tool adds metadata headers to `output`
- [ ] No private IPs, hostnames, credentials, or `.env` values included
